summary: The article accurately reports on Adani Green Energy's upcoming board meeting and past financial results, aligning with information from financial news outlets and the company's own investor relations. It provides a reliable overview for investors.

claims.claim: Adani Green Energy's Board will meet on July 22, 2026, to approve its Q1FY27 financial results.
claims.note: Multiple sources, including Mint and Adani Green Energy's corporate announcements, confirm the board meeting date for Q1FY27 results.

claims.claim: For the March-ending quarter (Q4FY26), the company reported a 34% year-on-year (YoY) increase in consolidated net profit to ₹514 crore.
claims.note: Financial news articles from Mint and Angel One, as well as Kotak Neo, confirm the Q4FY26 consolidated net profit and YoY increase.

claims.claim: Adani Green Energy's official quarterly results and investor presentations are typically uploaded on the stock exchanges (BSE and NSE) websites and on the "Investor Relations" section of the company's own website shortly after the board meeting.
claims.note: Adani Green Energy's investor relations page and stock exchange websites (BSE, NSE) are the standard locations for official results and presentations.

claims.claim: Adani Green Energy Limited (AGEL) has crossed 20 GW of operational renewable energy capacity, becoming the first renewable energy company in India to reach the milestone primarily through greenfield projects.
claims.note: A July 1, 2026 statement from Adani Green Energy confirms this milestone, as reported by SolarQuarter.

claims.claim: During FY26, the company added 5,051 MW of renewable capacity, which it said was the largest annual capacity addition by any company outside China.
claims.note: SolarQuarter, citing an Adani Green Energy statement, confirms the 5,051 MW capacity addition in FY26 and the claim of it being the largest outside China.

claims.claim: The company plans to expand battery storage capacity to 10 GWh in FY27 and 50 GWh over the next five years as part of its strategy to achieve 50 GW of renewable energy capacity by 2030.
claims.note: Both Alpha Spread and SolarQuarter report on Adani Green Energy's plans for battery storage and renewable energy capacity targets.

article_title: Adani Green Energy Q1FY27 Results: What to Watch For
